Description: The single-family residence includes a 2,634 square foot addition to the existing 4,183 square foot residence. New spaces include a second-floor primary suite, expanded first floor and lower level, elevator, and attached one-car garage. The total square footage will be 6,406 square feet. All additions meet the required setbacks and do not exceed the maximum building height (35’) or maximum average height (28’). Demolition includes removal of all existing finishes and fixtures, 43% of existing exterior walls, and 100% of existing roof structure.
